reviews.comment: If I'm being honest this class made me very anxious all semester. This is not a blow off class or an easy course where you can float by or miss a couple classes and be fine. The exams were very straightforward, but it's the quizzes that are often the source of many people's anxiety. The course content is very quality but hard to follow at times.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Tuhkanen is one of the best professors I've ever had. I always looked forward to his class because I knew I would learn something fascinating or see new perspectives. He is a very skilled lecturer and makes class enjoyable. Take him if you need an English class; you won't regret it. Just make sure to keep up with the readings and participate!
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This professor expects way to much from his students, like everyone who takes his class doesn't have other classes to worry about. From the readings, to the quizzes every week, to the exam that is lockdown browser 800-1000 words! I was putting more effort into trying to pass this class than having a life to live of my own. DO NOT TAKE THIS PROF!
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Attendance mandatory and quizzes over readings almost every class. Only 2 exams which are free response + one long essay question and he grades tough. Unless you really love literature don't take him

Contemporary Literary Theory was more modern philosophy than anything. I thought we were going to read novels but we read difficult essays by people like Marx or Freud. Lectures were hard to follow. Final paper? 50% of the grade. Thankfully we all did better than we thought. He was a fairly easy grader. Wouldn't recommend, though.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Lots of essays and close readings. I will say he makes it incredibly hard for no reason. Most arent English majors. The course is a level 2 and I think he grades too harshly. Making attendance mandatory, especially when you can record Zoom lectures 4 those that work, is unnecessary. Its a pandemic and I need to make rent.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: If you are looking for an easy english class this one is not it. Material is quite dense and you have to "close read" A LOT. Essays aren't hard but he is a tough grader don't be expecting to write an average paper and get an A or B.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dr. Tuhkanen's class has been one of the most thought provoking course I have taken yet. There is a lot of reading, writing papers, and a quiz every class but you learn quite a bit. He is really willing to work with his students if they're doing poorly. He gives you opportunities to get a better grade if you go talk to him and be honest. Thumbs up!
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: I absolutely loved this class and Mikko is amazing. I made an A but I really spent a lot of time on the essays. He only gives B's and A's for excellent/above average work. The class is reading, papers, movies, reading quizzes, and discussion based. There are no tests and the class is all discussion but you have to care to make a good grade.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Not an easy A, but possible! If you can keep up with the reading, you'll do fine. The class time is spent discussing the text. Enthusiastic professor about the material. 5 response papers, 3 annotated bibs, and a quiz per class. Quizzes are super easy, just keep up with material. Fair grader and appreciates student interaction. 10/10 recommend.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: This class is literally the worst I have ever taken. Abandon all hope, ye who enter here. Professor is incredibly rude and the content of the class is boring and nonsensical.

The WORST professor I have ever encountered. He is so incredibly disrespectful in his responses to his students. Online class that has weeks discussion (400 words) along with two responses (300 words each) and weekly quizzes. The reading material is interesting but incredibly time consuming. He offers no guiding/help for improving your grades.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: I will never take him again. SO much reading, SO many essays. The way he averages your final grade is completely unfair too... You get daily quizzes over 50+ pages of reading and quizzes are worth 50% of your grade. Cant just spark notes your way through, you have to actually read. Attendance was required. Don't take.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: I figured Gay and Lesbian Lit would be interesting, fun, and an insightful class with light, enjoyable reading. FALSE. The readings are usually interesting, but they're very long and require a lot of attention. Discussion post lengths are a little steep. Seems like busy work. Tough grader. DO NOT TAKE IF YOU'RE LOOKING FOR AN EASY CLASS

reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: Although the readings are pretty interesting most of the time, this class required around 150 pages of reading almost every week, in addition to 1500 word writings and then quizzes. There are no online lectures and you therefore have to interpret and write about the readings with little to nothing to go off of. Incredibly frustrating to work with.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--SO MANY PAPERS
